text:
Elena R.: FYI opened docs PR #7942 to update the migration guide with an SDK example. Noticed after the fact the sample contains a customer name and a private IP. Requesting legal + security signoff before merge. preview: https://deploy-preview-7942--docs.redwood.ai :wave:
Chris D.: thanks Elena. Can you paste the snippet here so we can triage quickly? We should avoid merging anything with real hostnames.
Elena R.: snippet below (current content):
```python
config = {
  "customer_name": "BetaCo",
  "endpoint": "api.internal.betaco.local",
  "callback_ip": "192.168.12.101"
}
```
Sam B. (Security): that callback_ip is in a private range — redact. Also run the sensitive-data scanner (`./tools/sensitive-scan.sh content || true`).
Nina L. (Legal): legal note: never publish customer-identifying names or internal hostnames. Replace with placeholders and add a short frontmatter flag indicating redaction for auditability.
Elena R.: proposed change: replace values with placeholders and add frontmatter keys. Example I'm about to push:
```yaml
---
redacted: true
redaction_reason: "contains customer identifiers and internal hostnames"
---
```
```python
config = {
  "customer_name": "[REDACTED_CUSTOMER]",
  "endpoint": "example.customer",
  "callback_ip": "[REDACTED_IPV4]"
}
```
Chris D.: docs request: keep the code runnable where possible (use example.customer for host). Add a short inline comment telling users to replace placeholders with their own values.
Elena R.: will do. Also adding a changelog entry noting the redaction and linking to audit ticket AUD-551.
scan-bot: [scan] Sensitive-data-scan: 1 match found in content/migration/sdk_examples.md line 18 (private IP). Recommendation: redact.
Elena R.: pushed commit 7a9d2f0 replacing occurrences, added frontmatter and changelog entry. PR description updated with AUD-551.
ci-bot: build #7942-preview: success 609 4a1 preview: https://deploy-preview-7942--docs.redwood.ai/en/migration/sdk_examples.html
Sam B. (Security): quick grep across branch: `rg -n "BetaCo|192\.168\.12\.101|api\.internal" || true` — no other matches. I'll run a follow-up scan.
scan-bot: [post-commit-scan] no sensitive matches detected in branch `pr/7942`.
Nina L. (Legal): legal approves once the frontmatter is present and AUD-551 is referenced in PR body. Please store a copy of the original pre-redaction snippet in the secure audit bucket and add a note with the bucket path in the PR for the record.
Elena R.: noted. I'll request a snapshot upload (secure-bucket/audits/AUD-551/pre-redaction/7942.json) and add the link in PR.
Chris D.: can someone from docs do a secondary review for style? @Elena R. pinging @Chris D. (that's me) 642. I'll review in a few.
Elena R.: thanks. Also ran `npm run linkcheck` and fixed one internal URL that broke linkcheck.
Chris D.: reviewed, small nit fixed in a follow-up commit (clarified placeholder comment).
Nina L. (Legal): confirming legal signoff. Approved :white_check_mark:
Sam B. (Security): security signoff as well. :shield:
ci-bot: build #7942-preview: final success 44d merging window open.
Elena R.: merging in ~3m after CI TTL to let any late comments surface. Thanks all for quick turnaround. :rocket:
